text:
nina: Quick sync 10: we're drafting the internal release blurb for the small rollout tomorrow (v2.15.1). Need a one-paragraph summary + explicit canary steps + rollback triggers.

nina: Keep it shortops wants something they can paste into #deploys.

carlos: Proposed paragraph (very short):
carlo s: "What: Enable request-prefix caching for the inference cache (flag: infra.cache.prefix_key). Impact: improves p90 for short/medium sequences, estimated ~8-12% p90 reduction for seq <=1024. Action: staged canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with monitoring. No DB or analytics schema changes."

devon: small edits: call out exact canary timing and the abort thresholds in the blurb. Also add the deploy commands.

sre-lead: Oncall note: @sre-oncall is primary; if they tag :rotating_light: we abort. Metrics to watch: requests/errors/p95 and CPU on inference nodes.

carlos: Updated draft: 
- What: request-prefix cache opt-in (infra.cache.prefix_key).
- Impact: 8-12% improvement to p90 for sequences <=1024; reduces token compute for short prompts.
- Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.1 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (60m) -> prod. Manual toggle via Console > Feature Flags > infra.cache.prefix_key.

- Rollback (short): abort if error rate increases by >0.5% absolute OR p95 latency regresses >20% for 30m.

ops-bot: Suggested deploy snippet for channel (copy-paste):
```
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.1 --canary 5
# wait 30m, check dashboards
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.1 --canary 25
# wait 60m, then /deploy --env prod --tag v2.15.1
```

nina: Legal wants a single sentence confirming data access.

legal-bot: Affirmation: "No new customer data is persisted or exported; this only touches cached inference lookups."

devon: I'll paste dashboard links once we finalize. Recommend these monitors: https://dash.redwood/inference/p90 , https://dash.redwood/inference/errors , https://dash.redwood/inference/node-cpu

sre-lead: Also add a short pin: "Version pin: v2.15.1; rollback path: revert flag + rollback to tag v2.15.0". That way platform knows exact fallback.

carlos: Final internal blurb (one block below, ready to paste into #deploys):
"""
:sparkles: What: request-prefix cache opt-in (flag: infra.cache.prefix_key).
:zap: Impact: ~8-12% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB or analytics schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.15.1 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (60m) -> prod. Enable via Console > Feature Flags > infra.cache.prefix_key. Version pin: v2.15.1.
:rotating_light: Rollback: abort if error rate +0.5% absolute OR p95 latency +20% sustained for 30m. Rollback path: disable flag + deploy tag v2.15.0.
:link: Dashboards: p90 / errors / node-cpu (links in thread).
:person_with_turban: Oncall: @sre-oncall
No new customer data persisted; only cached inference traffic affected.
"""

nina: Perfect. I'll schedule this to post at T-25 and then kick the canary at T.

devon: I'll add the three dashboard shortlinks and pin after deploy-bot updates.

sre-lead: I'll be watching; will call abort in thread if thresholds breach.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: tag=v2.15.1 env=staging canary=5% (id:1722509999). Use `/deploy status 1722509999` for logs.

nina: Thanks everyone 1— saving final copy to release-notes repo after live post.
